heading.title: Of Grant of Probate and Letters of Administration

article.title: Acts not validated by administration.
article.content:
221Acts not validated by administration.

Section 221  ·  Part IX · Chapter I  ·  page 70 of the Act
Letters of administration do not render valid any intermediate acts of the administrator tending to the diminution or damage of the intestate’s estate.
